objective: Perform the "DISCOVERY" role for work item "Add CSV export to the reporting dashboard".

input.workItemTitle: Add CSV export to the reporting dashboard
input.workItemDescription: Users on the analytics team need to export the current reporting dashboard view as a CSV file for offline analysis. No specific format or column list has been agreed yet.

result.summary: The work item requests adding a CSV export feature to the reporting dashboard so that analytics team members can download the current view for offline analysis.
findings: Target users are members of the analytics team.
The required feature is a CSV export capability for the reporting dashboard.
The export should capture the current view of the reporting dashboard.
The intended use case for the exported CSV is offline analysis.

uncertainty.statement: The specific CSV file format and list of included columns have not been defined or agreed upon.
